content:
watchOS 27 is the next major software update for Apple Watch, and among its many new features, it will add two brand new apps to your watch.

#1: Siri App

Siri will undergo a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, and part of that is a brand new Siri app.

The Siri app will be available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 will still let you invoke Siri via the Digital Crown, but this app is another place where you can have conversations. More importantly, this app lets you browse your past conversation history.

Siri AI will feel more like a real person than ever before, and will keep a history of your queries across all your devices. So the Siri app in watchOS 27 will not only show conversations from your Apple Watch, but also from your iPhone, Mac, and other devices.

You can find the full list of Apple Watch models compatible with Siri AI here.

#2: Find My App

Alongside the new features coming to the Find My app in iOS 27, Apple is also rethinking the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In watchOS 26, Find My is currently split into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People.

But in watchOS 27, Apple is unifying all of the Find My features into a single, new Find My app.

Find My on Apple Watch offers all the features of the previous three apps, but in a more streamlined experience so you can easily find any item or person in a map-centric interface.

You can switch between different Find My categories via the menu in the top-left corner, but otherwise the interface stays the same.
